facts.content: Patient reports being unable to move the left arm since waking about one hour ago.

facts.content: Patient has painless, persistent paralysis of the left upper extremity.
Patient reports left facial tingling since symptom onset.
Patient reports dribbling when drinking and difficulty swallowing.
Patient reports that speech is harder and slower.
Patient denies any left leg symptoms.
Patient denies hand discoloration or coldness.
Patient reports no prior similar episodes.
Patient reports sleep was as usual before symptom onset.
Patient has a history of type 2 diabetes mellitus.
Patient has a history of hypertension.
Patient takes metformin.
Patient takes losartan.
Patient takes amlodipine.
Patient is allergic to penicillin.
Patient's father had heart disease.
Patient lives alone.
Patient is a former smoker.
Patient drinks beers, a few on weekends and a couple during the week.
facts.source_text: etOH: beers—few on weekends + couple during week

facts.content: Encounter was conducted by telephone with no visualization, vital signs, or physical examination performed.
